_note: Ad bank. Every business, place, and person is invented (see newsroom/lore.json); nothing here stands for anything real. status: draft until the owner approves an ad; week is its slot in the posting order.

ads.kicker: Tanner's Row · Est. before the last cave-in
ads.artAlt: a woodcut of a handcart piled with barrels, bedrolls, and a sword
ads.headline: The Trailmaster Pack
pitch: Now with a strap that holds.
ads.tagline: Outfitting the Undermaw's finest, and its most recent.
ads.finePrint: Not rated for the Undermaw below level three. Pocket forty is the manufacturer's. Recalled Trailmaster bags may be returned, if found.
ads.question: What does your party keep in pocket forty?

ads.kicker: By appointment to nobody who complained
ads.artAlt: a woodcut of a town crier ringing a hand bell
ads.headline: Invest in Your Afterlife
pitch: Our founder certainly plans to be.
ads.tagline: Now merged with Ledgerhall. The skeletons are staying.
ads.finePrint: Past returns are no guarantee of future unlife. Withdrawals processed in the order the clerks remember them. Vaultmere Holdings is not a cult. Please stop asking.
ads.question: Would you trust a lich with your gold? Asking for a counting house.

ads.kicker: Tanner's Row · Doors open at dusk
ads.artAlt: a woodcut of an empty hanging shop sign with a bell
ads.headline: Cellar Night Is Back
pitch: Whole-price ale for anything that climbs out.
Bards perform at their own risk.
ads.tagline: The deepest cellar in Brindlemoor. We checked. Mostly.
ads.finePrint: No responsibility taken for sounds below the third barrel. Walk-in cooler under new management. Adventurers drink free if they come back up.
ads.question: Your party is drinking at the Mule when the cellar door starts knocking. Who opens it?

ads.kicker: Delivering Brindlemoor, in whole or in part
ads.artAlt: a woodcut of a goblin courier shouting, arms full of papers
ads.headline: Same-Day Owlbear Delivery
ads.tagline: Proudly listed on the Brindlemoor exchange.
ads.finePrint: Parcels that smell of fish, honey, or the previous courier travel at the sender's risk. Hootline is not liable for any parcel the owlbear decides is his.
ads.question: An owlbear delivers your party a parcel that has clearly been opened. What's missing?

ads.kicker: Seers to the discerning since last Tuesday
ads.artAlt: a woodcut of an open chest blazing with light
ads.headline: Your Future, Monthly
pitch: Basic tier: the next five minutes.
Premium: next week, with fewer ads.
ads.tagline: Lumenwick. You knew we would say that.
ads.finePrint: Futures shown are illustrative. Prophecies may contain advertising. Cancellations take effect on a date the crystal has already foreseen.
ads.question: Your crystal ball shows one free vision a month. What does your character ask it?

ads.artAlt: a woodcut of a dragon weather vane above an arrow pointing the way
ads.headline: Home for Christmas in No Time
pitch: Every circle open through the holidays.
Arrive before you leave, or ride free.
One of you guaranteed. Extras no charge.
ads.tagline: Hopwell Transit. You're already there. Mostly.
ads.finePrint: Duplicate passengers share one seat and one name. Luggage arrives separately, sometimes in a different year. Hopwell is not responsible for whoever meets you at the far circle.
ads.question: Hopwell delivers two of your character home for Christmas. Which one does the family keep?

ads.kicker: Tanner's Row · Christmas Eve, all night
ads.artAlt: a woodcut of a smiling innkeeper with a big mustache and an apron
ads.headline: The Christmas Eve Feast
ads.tagline: Keeper Harrowgate pours. Nobody leaves hungry.
ads.finePrint: Seats by the fire for paying guests. Seats in the cellar for whatever was already down there. Carolers welcome until the second verse.
ads.question: Your party spends Christmas Eve at the Mule. Who carves the goose, and what's inside it?

ads.artAlt: a woodcut of a wax seal stamped with a d20, a quill, and a sword
ads.headline: New Year, New Policy
pitch: Renew by the first. We'll know if you don't.
ads.tagline: Shieldwall Mutual. We've already read your file.
ads.finePrint: Excludes dragons, liches, the Undermaw below level five, and anything the party was warned about. After the second, a resurrection is a pre-existing condition.
ads.question: Shieldwall wants your party's year in writing for the renewal. Which claim gets denied?
